items.title: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
items.summary: The discount chain has fallen into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer.

items.title: RAF 'moving aircraft to hangars at night to protect them from drone threats'
items.summary: The Royal Air Force is moving aircraft to hangars and hardened shelters at night to protect them from possible drone threats, it is understood.

items.title: Gordon Ramsay to host Top Gear as show revived after Flintoff crash
items.summary: Ramsay will take the driving seat alongside as yet unnamed co-presenters when the show starts filming next year.

items.title: Two men appear in court accused of stealing cufflinks and a clock from William and Kate's home
items.summary: Two men have appeared in court accused of stealing cufflinks and a clock from the Norfolk home of the Prince and Princess of Wales.

items.title: Wife drugged and raped by husband asked police if she was to blame, court hears
items.summary: The woman told a court suggestions she was 'pretending to be asleep' were 'absolute rubbish'.

items.title: Murder investigation launched as woman, 80, dies after being set on fire
items.summary: Police have launched a murder investigation after an 80-year-old woman who was set on fire outside her flat died.
